title: Choose the next steps to cut CI time

elements.markdown: Each of four jobs repeats a 2-minute dependency install; integration tests take 11 minutes against a shared Postgres database. These are opportunities, not measured savings. Release coverage stays intact. Combine options below; defaults are editable proposals.

options.description: Establish install and integration timings and check reliability before changing CI.
Try caching to reduce repeated installs; cold misses and cache correctness still need testing.
Separate Postgres state per shard; faster feedback may cost more runner minutes.
Avoid unnecessary matrix runs for proven docs-only changes; keep release checks.

Measure first.placeholder: Leave blank for me to pick three representative recent PRs.

options.description: Compare cold and warm runs; key by OS, runtime, and lockfile before adopting.
Change the workflow now and verify misses, invalidation, and platform-specific behavior.
Strong isolation, with additional startup and runner overhead.
Share an instance; first verify tests do not modify instance-wide state.
Inspect fixtures and shared state before choosing a safe sharding design.

options.value: Estimate and ask before increasing spend
options.description: Prepare the sharding plan without authorizing a cost increase.

options.value: Allow an increase within a limit
options.description: Proceed only if the projected additional monthly cost fits your limit.

Parallelize integration tests.default: Estimate and ask before increasing spend

Allow an increase within a limit.input: Maximum additional monthly runner cost, including currency
Allow an increase within a limit.placeholder: For example, USD 30/month; a blank value requires clarification.

Filter docs-only PRs.input: Docs-only paths, if you have a preferred definition
Filter docs-only PRs.placeholder: Leave blank for me to inspect paths and propose conservative filters. Build inputs still run the matrix.

options.value: Keep Linux, macOS, and Windows on every code PR
options.description: Preserve early checks for all supported CLI platforms.

options.value: Linux on PRs; all platforms nightly and on releases
options.description: Explicitly reduce PR coverage; supported-platform regressions may be found later.

elements.default: Keep Linux, macOS, and Windows on every code PR
